name: @dsh-external/dsh-refusal-guard
description: DSH host-plane refusal-repair proximity injection for the five security presets: watches assistant turn text on session/event, detects refusal/moralizing patterns (two-tier: strong phrases full-text + weak keywords head-150, ), and when a hit lands re-injects a one-shot authorized-context reminder as a dynamic systemPrompt context contribution. RuntimeContextProjection dedupes: the reminder lands only when it appears (text change) and disappears after the repaired turn (change back to empty) — steady state costs nothing. Non-security presets resolve no preset id and render nothing.
author: SeaOf0
